notes.title: Update v1.1.0
notes.content:
This update aims to add some new mechanics as well as lots of quality-of-life additions and bug fixes.
Enjoy!

Additions:

 Resident 401 can now break cameras (play to find out more).
 ?????? (play to find out more).
 Added a new camera to the top of the stairs (camera G-2).
 Camera monitor buttons that have no corresponding camera (i.e. G-3 and G-4) will now show 'No Signal' when selected instead of doing nothing.
 Added a folder to the desk that may contain some useful information about the facility and its residents.
 The escape key can now be used to go back when focused (e.g. when at the terminal) as well as clicking at the bottom of the screen.
 Added a new zoom action (RMB by default) that can be used when not in free roam to get a better look at certain things.
 Added rebind options for movement (WASD by default) and interact (LMB by default).
 Added option to invert look axes when in free roam.
 Added option to reduce light flickering or disable it entirely.
 Added a cursor to the terminal to indicate when input is active.
 Added aliases for terminal commands (e.g. "analyze power" will now work as well as "analyse power").
 Added a clock to the office that represents current progress.
 Added new models for active power and vent faults to make them more easily identifiable as broken.
 Added new achievements for completing each mode.


Fixes:

 Fixed a pathfinding issue that could cause residents to take unnecessarily long paths.
 Fixed power cuts happening after stabilising power.
 Fixed level 4 security doors being able to be opened when the power is off.
 Fixed an issue that left the player in a bad state after interacting with a door at the same time as Resident 401.
 Fixed text input on the terminal not working correctly for other keyboard layouts (NOTE: English is still the only language available but other keyboard layouts can now be used to enter text into the terminal).
 Fixed missing wall texture on level 4.
 Fixed material on security gates being too shiny with lots of bloom.

notes.title: Update v1.0.2
notes.content:
Fixes

Fixed death animation being dark if power is off when player dies.
Fixed office encounters happening too frequently.

notes.title: Update v1.0.1
notes.content:
Changes

 Removed shout ability since it didn't have much use and could be confusing.
 Minor AI tweaks.
 Widened flashlight beam.
 Difficulty balancing: overall, difficulty has increased slightly.
 Reduced total number of power faults for all difficulties to prevent games lasting too long.
 Added sounds to terminal.
 Changed highest intensity music track.
 Low air quality effects will now appear earlier.
 Lowered volume for gate and door sounds.

Fixes

 Fixed UI scaling issues.
 Fixed AI pathfinding issues.
 Fixed instances of music playing incorrectly.
